content:
Screens 5.10 delivered two highly-requested desktop features to users earlier this month. Now the app is back with a fun update for iPhone Duo users: tiny laptop mode.

iPhone Duo supports various positions including a partially opened configuration. iOS 27 allows apps to respond to the hinge position, offering unique experiences as a result.

Edovia, the makers of Screens, took this as an opportunity to make the remote desktop viewer transform iPhone Duo into what it looks like in this mode: a very miniature notebook computer.

“Simply fold your iPhone Duo halfway to turn it into a pocket-sized workstation, with your remote desktop on the upper half and a custom keyboard and trackpad below,” Edovia says.

“The trackpad supports the same familiar gestures you’ve come to expect from Screens, while the custom keyboard supports multiple languages, follows your selected system keyboard language, and lets you swipe down on keys to access secondary characters, just like on iPad.”

They show off the update in full on their website here. Screens for iPhone Duo is available on the App Store.
